sub: Templates, login keys and boot scripts.

Overview.p: An AMI is a template with the OS and software used to launch instances. A key pair gives secure SSH login. User data is a script that runs the first time the instance boots.
AMI = a ready photocopy of a computer. Key pair = the key to open it. User data = a to-do note it follows on first boot.
A team bakes a custom AMI with its app installed, so every new server in Auto Scaling starts identical and ready.
AMI = Template • Key = Login • User data = Boot script

items: Pick an AMI (AWS, Marketplace or your own)
Select or create a key pair
User data runs once at first boot

Examples.p: a hardened image used by every team.
new servers start from your AMI.
user data installs a web server at launch.

code: aws ec2 create-key-pair --key-name my-key --query KeyMaterial --output text > my-key.pem
aws ec2 copy-image --source-image-id ami-0abc123 --source-region ap-south-1 --region us-east-1 --name my-app-copy

CLI Commands.p: IDs like i-0abc123 and sg-0abc123 are examples. Replace them with your real IDs.
